d:
MRT Music Kannada presents “Ganga Yamuna Sangama” Lyrical Video Song from the evergreen Kannada movie Anuraga Aralithu, featuring Dr. Rajkumar, Madhavi and Geetha.
This timeless melody is sung by Dr. Rajkumar and S. Janaki, with music composed by Upendra Kumar and lyrics penned by legendary lyricist Chi. Udayashankar. The film was directed by M. S. Rajashekar.
Movie: Anuraga Aralithu
Directed by: M. S. Rajashekar
Produced by: M. S. Puttaswamy
Artist Name: Dr.Rajkumar, Madhavi, Geetha
Music Director: Upendra Kumar
Cinematography: V. K. Kannan
